sloka: भस्मना च आवृतम् सर्वम् सम्मूढम् इव तत् बलम् ।वसिष्ठ ऋषयः च अन्ये राजा च ससुतः तदा ॥१-७४-१५॥
transliteration: bhasmanā ca āvṛtam sarvam sammūḍham iva tat balam ।vasiṣṭha ṛṣayaḥ ca anye rājā ca sasutaḥ tadā ॥1-74-15॥

translations.english: The Sun was wrapped in dark. The quarters were devoid of brightness. The entire army was covered with ashes, as if they fainted.
